newsitem.title: USA: Telxon sees Q4 oper shr $0.25.
newsitem.headline: Telxon sees Q4 oper shr $0.25.

text.p: Telxon Corp said Monday it expects to report fiscal fourth quarter operating earnings of $0.25 per share, but will take a charge of $0.22 per share from the retirement of its long-time chairman and chief executive.
The company said preliminary results for the quarter, ended March 31, include revenues of $121 million. Full results will be released May 20.
In the year-ago quarter the company reported revenues of $144.9 million. Operating earnings per share were not immediately available.
Telxon said it supported analysts' estimates of continued revenue and earnings growth for 1998.
Robert Meyerson retired as chairman and chief executive in February after 25 years of service. Frank Brick replaced him as chief executive and Raj Reddy took on the chairmanship.
Telxon officials were not available for comment on the $0.22-per-share charge.
Texlon makes wireless and mobile transaction systems.
